scenes.why: The turn: the product the guide itself hands over to, named and shown on its real screen, captioned with its listing's line closest to what the guide teaches. Screen: "Lisbon and Porto" (The trip: where you are now, destinations, and every booking with its reference, with Record a change on each.) chosen because it is the real screen closest to "An immediate answer to what else a change touches, walked one booking at a time."; focus on "Not currently at a recorded destination".
Ends on where to read the whole guide, with the product beneath it: the viewer leaves with the next step, not only a pitch.

reasoning.decision: Pinterest video pin, 1000×1500, 12–35s, hook by 1s, sound off
reasoning.because: People are planning, not scrolling: idea-led, calm and save-worthy, worded like what they searched for. Muted, looping, slow; a hard sell reads as an ad and loses the save.
